# dsh-flash-presets —— 组合包补丁层（bundle patch）
# 本文件叠加两个预设：
#   轻量PTC-v3 lite（flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite，13 条，默认）、轻量PTC-v3 balance（flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance，3 条）、
#   旧 id（flash-lean-ptc-v3 等）由 lib/preset-alias.js 运行时映射，不建兼容卡。
#   node scripts/compose-bundle-patch.mjs          # 两个预设都进 bundle
# CI 会断言本文件与合成结果一致，请勿手工编辑。
- insert:
    - id: preset-flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite
        name: "轻量PTC-v3 lite"
        description: "效率最高的轻量预设，适用于绝大部分日常工作。"
        order: 27
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              suffix: |-
                FLASH OPERATING RULES (hard constraints; they override habit and tool default wording):

                BUDGET FIRST
                1. Turn budget, not step budget. Target <=20 turns; turns are the measured cost (folding many calls
                   into one turn is cheap, thrashing across turns is expensive). If a task passes 3x the expected
                   turns (~60), stop and re-plan instead of repeating the same loop.
                2. Deliberate briefly. Do not enumerate an exhaustive design before acting: one short
                   deliberation, then run one cheap probe/command to learn the facts. Acting beats more planning.
                3. Input/answer-type tasks (submit a file or an answer): produce the SMALLEST artifact that
                   satisfies the stated constraints first; refine only while you are under the turn budget.
                4. Gate before delivery, not after. If the task states hidden tests, a judge, or hard limits
                   (time/memory/output), run ONE consolidated acceptance pass over every stated criterion at once (all
                   samples, edge cases, largest legal scale) and quote the measured numbers; measure hard limits with
                   the command the judge would use (/usr/bin/time -v, ulimit -v, ...), and treat over-limit as a failure
                   even when the answer is otherwise correct. Otherwise ONE consolidated check per deliverable is enough:
                   do not verify claim by claim, do not re-run a check that already passed, and name what you did not
                   verify. Once the gate passes, stop testing and deliver: do not add extra randomized or stress rounds unless the gate itself failed.

                5. Tool choice. Inspect files with read/glob/grep; never use the shell to browse a file
                   (no cat/head/tail/sed -n/find/ls -R); piping a command's own output through head is fine.
                6. Output budget. Batch independent calls into one step. Pipe or redirect long output
                   (| head -40; redirect to "$env:TEMP/out.log" in PowerShell, %TEMP%\out.log in cmd, /tmp/out.log on POSIX).
                   Never print a dump you could grep.
                7. Programmatic tool mode, adaptively. Fold 3+ independent calls of one logical step into ONE
                   run_code program; if a step needs exactly one call, call it directly. Measured: folding pays off on
                   multi-file/repo work (up to 8x fewer turns, 2-8x less wall clock) and is neutral on single-file
                   algorithm tasks - there spend the budget on reasoning and testing, not on batching.
                8. Context discipline (biggest measured lever). Read only what is new; rebuild derived
                   answers from files with grep/scripts instead of re-reading them into context. Keep NOTES
                   short and factual (<=60 lines).
                9. Author incrementally: create a file once (skeleton), then extend it with edit. Never
                   re-emit an unchanged file. After two failed shell patches, switch to the editor.

                SAFETY
                10. Answer in the user's language. Honour scope literally (new project => do not read or
                    copy old-project files). Use subagents only when the user asks or the harness delegates; never spawn them to look busy.
                11. Never put secrets, tokens or private raw material into the session; reference by path.

                WHEN BLOCKED
                12. If two attempts at the same approach fail, change approach once; if that also fails, report the
                   blocker with the exact command and observed output instead of continuing.
                13. Route awareness: running on provider "{{provider}}" with model "{{model}}". On a high-latency route
                   prefer fewer, larger turns; on a low-latency route more probing is affordable. Never trade
                   correctness for turn count.
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until exit_plan_mode succeeds or the user switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
                # FLASH TUNING: 该路由声明 1,000,000 窗口，0.8 默认要到 800k 才压缩；
                # 实测：长会话里大量步数停在 300k 以上，本预设取 0.25 阈值 / 保留 20000 近期轮次。
                config:
                  thresholdRatio: 0.25
                  retainTokens: 20000
                  compactionRetries: 1
                  auto: true
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-codex
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: codex
                  toolName: subagent_codex
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: claude-code
                  toolName: subagent_claude_code
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
                disabled: true
              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: tool-presentation
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation'
            config:
              mode: ptc
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true

readme.text:
dsh-flash-presets

中文 | English

为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 调校的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）agent 预设。

它做的事情很朴素：上下文更早压缩，过长的工具输出只留头尾，用不上的工具不进系统提示，零碎的工具调用尽量并进一段 `run_code`。模型不会因此变聪明；变的是一次会话读多少、绕多少、何时收尾。

整个包以 DSH 组合包（`dsh.bundle`）交付：向 profile 插入预设行，不改宿主源码。**有三项是运行时对整个 profile 生效的**：常驻 PTC 运行时（补丁里的 `ptc-runtime` 覆盖，作用到该 profile 的**所有**预设，要关只能移除这张插件卡）、`glob` / `grep` 的只读并发标记（`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` 关闭）、旧 preset id 的解析（`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS=0` 关闭）。

> 当前版本：v0.2.8（2026-11-06）· 预设 v3 lite / v3 balance · 计划模式 plan-mode v1（1.0.0）· 要求 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.3-0`（`engines` 闸：安装时会拒装，启动加载时区间外的 DSH 会跳过本插件，可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 自担风险放行；脚本安装不经过这道闸），实测 0.2.1-rc.5 与 0.2.2-rc.1
>
> 从 npm 安装请写死版本号：`dsh-flash-presets@0.2.8`。**不要装 0.2.5** —— 它在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 上无法新建会话（#19）。

**适合**

- 目标清楚、有验收标准的任务：改代码、跑脚本、整理数据、按格式出交付物。
- 长会话。默认压缩阈值是上下文的 80%，多数会话根本触发不了；本预设改为 25%，长会话的上下文因此保持在可控范围。
- 在意 token 账单、又不想在每条消息里反复叮嘱模型的人。

**不适合**

- 明显超出模型能力的难题，比如竞赛级、以拿部分分为目标的题目。这类任务上标准模式更稳，数据见[实测证据](docs/实测证据.md)。
- 依赖当前日期、对话内安装插件或定时任务的工作流：这几项能力在预设里被裁掉了（见[与官方 PTC 预设的差异](#与官方-ptc-预设的差异)）。
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 以外的模型。规则可能仍然有用，但没有验证过。
- DSH 低于 0.2.1-rc.5 的版本（含 0.2.1-rc.2～rc.4）。旧版本请用对应的旧版包（见[版本与兼容性](docs/版本与兼容性.md)）；DSH 0.1.7 以前的目录式预设，0.2.6 起不再提供。

四个机制分别作用在会话的四个时刻，彼此不重叠：

| 机制 | 作用时刻 | 设置 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 轮次压缩 | 上下文存量过大时 | `thresholdRatio: 0.25`，`retainTokens: 20000`（官方默认 0.8） | 历史换成摘要，长会话才触发 |
| 工具输出裁剪 | 工具结果进入上下文时 | 头 4096 / 尾 1024 字符 | 每条过长输出只留两端 |
| 关闭插件 | 组装系统提示时 | 6 个插件 `disabled: true` | 这些工具的 schema 不进提示，固定省一笔 |
| 行为纪律 | 模型每一步决策时 | persona 规则（lite 13 条，balance 3 条） | 引导少读、批量调用、增量改写 |

另外两项随包生效：

- 工具面使用 PTC（`tool-presentation: ptc`），PTC 运行时改为会话内常驻（`ptc-runtime: persistent-in-memory`）。实测每个 program 的固定启动成本从 108 ms 降到约 0（按收益模型计），嵌套工具调用从 44 ms 降到 15 ms（[压测记录](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/blob/main/docs/压测-run_code开销.md)）。收益随单个 program 内的调用次数线性增长，只跑一条命令的短任务几乎无感。
- 插件在运行时为 `glob` / `grep` 补上只读并发标记，同一轮里的多个搜索可以并行执行（仅插件管理器安装的 web / desktop profile；脚本安装没有这一项，`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` 可关）。

逐项原理与源码行号见[技术文档 · 省 token 的四套机制](docs/技术文档-省token四机制.md)。

| 预设 | id | 规则 | 压缩 | 何时用 |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 轻量PTC-v3 lite（原 lean-v3） | `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite` | 13 | 0.25 / 20k | 默认。适合绝大多数日常工作 |
| 轻量PTC-v3 balance | `flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance` | 3 | 0.25 / 20k | 规则更少，留给模型更多发挥空间 |

两者共享同一套压缩、裁剪、插件与 PTC 配置，区别只在 persona 规则。

lite 的 13 条规则分五组：预算（按轮而不是按步计，目标 20 轮以内，超过约 60 轮就停下重新规划）、动手顺序（短判断加一次廉价探测，提交型任务先交最小可行产物）、验证（验收一次通过即交付，不追加随机测试与压测）、工具与输出（用 read/glob/grep 读文件，批量调用，增量改写）、交付与范围（按用户语言作答，守住范围，不把密钥写进会话，同一路子失败两次就换）。

balance 只保留引擎替代不了的三条：守住语言与范围、不写密钥、连败两次就换路子并报告确切的命令和输出。

规则条数该怎么选，我们测过：三组任务上最多对比 0、3、7、13 条规则（算法床四臂齐全，另两床只有 0/3/13 与 3/13），n = 5–15，质量和 token 都没有测出可区分的差异（[实测证据](docs/实测证据.md)「三床 × 四臂」）。这个规模测不出小于约 2 倍的差异，所以结论是「没有观察到差异」，不是「没有差异」。省下的 token 主要来自上表里前三个机制和 PTC，而不是规则文本。

> 读实测记录时注意命名：2026-11-04 的那批实验里，「v3」指 13 条规则的版本（即现在的 lite），「lite」指 3 条规则的版本（即现在的 balance）。0.2.6 发布时做了这次改名。
下面每组数字都标明了条件与样本量。不同实验之间口径不同，请不要跨表比较。

两套虚构的日常办公数据处理任务：[办公基准 v1](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/tree/main/benchmarks/office/base-v1)（8 题）与[办公追加 v1](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/tree/main/benchmarks/office/addendum-v1)（5 题）。表中为每个配置的平均 token，含缓存读取，单位百万；OPS 指 [dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops)。

- `lean-v3` 是 0.2.5 时期的 13 条规则版，与现在的 lite 规则相同。
- 「相对标准模式」同时包含了 PTC 工具面的收益。只看预设本身，应与 PTC 模式比：两个套件上分别约为 −59.6% 与 −69.2%（由表中数字算出）。
- 表里只有 token。运行记录里每一轮都判为全对，因此不单列正确率（逐题分数不在本仓库）。出题与评分使用同一个模型（`GPT-6.1-Sol`），但答题环节读不到真值与评分器。
- `OPS + PTC` 在办公基准 v1 上只有 4 次有效运行。两个套件任务不同，不合并排名。
- 评分规则公开在 [`benchmarks/office/grading/`](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/tree/main/benchmarks/office/grading)，真值与评分器放在私有仓库。

插件管理器会装上整张插件卡：两个预设、计划模式组件、常驻 PTC 运行时，以及旧 id 兼容层。

```console

readme.section: 0.2.8：npm 上按版本号装（锁死版本）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-flash-presets@0.2.8

readme.section: 不想走 npm 时，装同一个 tag
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets#v0.2.8
```

`--profile` 通常取 `web` 或 `desktop`（`headless` 下预设不激活、`acp` 未验证，见[已知限制](#已知限制)）。在 GUI 的「插件 → 添加插件」里填包名或 GitHub 地址，效果相同。

预设直接决定 agent 的行为，需要可复现时请写死版本号。用 npm 包名且不带版本号时，管理器写入的是 caret 范围，之后任何一次 pnpm 操作都可能把它升到 0.2.x 的最新版；`github:` 安装写的是 git 引用（`#v0.2.8`），不会自己漂移。

从 [Release](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/releases) 下载附件解压，或克隆对应的 tag：

```bash
git clone --depth 1 -b v0.2.8 https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets.git
cd dsh-flash-presets
bash scripts/install.sh --profile web                  # Windows：scripts\install.ps1 -Profile web
```

脚本只向 profile 补丁写入一个托管块，里面是两个预设行；写入前会备份原文件，重复运行不会产生第二份。计划模式组件、旧 id 兼容层、组合自检与 `glob`/`grep` 并发标记属于插件本体，只有通过插件管理器安装才会加载。加 `--with-runtime`（旧名 `--with-plan-mode`；PowerShell 为 `-WithRuntime`）时，脚本会额外把 profile 级的 `ptc-runtime: persistent-in-memory` 写进该 profile —— 这一项对该 profile 的**所有**预设生效，`--uninstall` 会一并撤掉。

两条路径**二选一**：已经用脚本写过预设，要改装插件卡，请先 `--uninstall`。两条都装不会报错（`--dump-config` 仍退出 0），但选择器里每个预设会出现两张卡（实测补丁里 8 行预设）。`agent-preset/invalid` 是**预设定义解析失败**时的错误码，不是重复注册。

预设和运行时配置都在进程启动时读取一次。

- `web` profile：刷新页面即可。
- `desktop`：完全退出宿主后再启动。不重启的典型表现是「插件已装，但 `run_code` 优化没有生效」。
- `headless` / `acp`：预设本来就不激活（headless 实测；acp 未验证），不涉及重启。

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c 'id: preset-'             # 6（内置 4 条 + 本包 2 条；未装其他预设包时）
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c 'persistent-in-memory'    # 1
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c 'plan-mode-ui'            # 1
node scripts/doctor.mjs --profile web                                # 版本、重复行、!!js、YAML 解析一次查完
这几条 `node scripts/...` 假设你在仓库（或解压后的 Release 附件）里。用插件管理器装的话，脚本在 profile 里：`node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-flash-presets/scripts/doctor.mjs --profile web`。

更新：重新执行同一条 `add`，或先 `remove` 再 `add`。

卸载：

```console
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-flash-presets     # 插件管理器安装的
bash scripts/install.sh --uninstall --profile web     # 脚本安装的（Windows：scripts\install.ps1 -Uninstall）
```

pnpm 会在该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里留下一行本包记录，`remove` 不会清掉它。这一行不影响配置合成。

- 预设 id 变了：13 条规则版由 `flash-lean-ptc-v3` 改为 `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite`，原来 3 条规则的 `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite` 改名为 `flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance`。
- 旧会话照常打开：运行时兼容层把 5 个本包发布过的历史 id（`flash-lean`、`flash-lean-ptc`、`-v1`、`-v2`、`-v3`）解析到 lite；本机实验用的 id 可用 `DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS_EXTRA` 追加。它只在解析失败时介入，不改写任何会话文件。映射表见 [`presets/legacy-preset-map.json`](presets/legacy-preset-map.json)，原理见[预设 id 契约与升级](docs/预设-id-契约与升级.md)。
- 装过独立包 `dsh-plan-mode-ui` 的，先 `dsh plugin remove dsh-plan-mode-ui`，否则计划模式会被注入两次。
- 如果 profile 的 `selectedDefault` 还指向旧 id，新建会话会报 `Unknown agent preset`，改成 `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite` 即可。

同一张插件卡里还有计划模式组件 plan-mode v1（1.0.0）：同一个回合里先写计划，经你批准后再执行，结束时把实测的验收数字写回卡片。它与预设各管一件事：预设管每一轮怎么花，计划模式管这个回合先想清楚再动手。

- 入口在输入框左侧，档位为 off / light / full，与预设设置相互独立。
- 默认推荐 light。在 n = 3、7 项验收的对比中，两档都是 3/3 全过，full 的 token 多约 17%（中位 40.2 k vs 34.3 k）、耗时多约 33%（196 s vs 147 s，[变更日志](docs/CHANGELOG.md)）。
- 不用时在卡片里关掉这个组件即可，预设行为不受影响。

- **先给目标和验收标准。** 标准越明确，效果越好；边界不清时配合 plan 或 goal 模式（P15654 的对照见[实测证据](docs/实测证据.md)）。
- **把输出上限调高。** 建议 120K 以上，条件允许就设到 384K，避免长时间推理被截断。
- **Windows 用户**建议先装好 PowerShell 7（MSI 版）或 Git Bash。
- **长思考模型一题一会话。** 一次塞多道题，模型可能把全部计划铺进同一个响应，在动手之前就被上游断流（[实测证据](docs/实测证据.md)「跨模型」）。

先跑一次体检，再下判断：

```bash
node scripts/doctor.mjs --profile web          # 加 --dump 顺带跑 dsh --dump-config
node scripts/diag-preset-load.mjs --profile desktop   # GUI 里预设卡片显示「加载失败」时用
```

| 症状 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 预设卡片显示「加载失败」 | 预设里引用的插件在本机解析不到。最常见的是自行改预设时写了 `.../dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents`，该子路径在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 已移除 | 用 `diag-preset-load.mjs` 定位，删掉那一行 |
| 斜杠菜单里「压缩 / 计划 / 目标」消失，下一句报 `tool executor is unavailable` | 插件热重载后，已打开会话的预设组合被释放，没有自动重挂 | 重启 DSH。插件每 2 分钟自检一次并在日志里写明处置；设置 `DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_SELFCHECK_HEAL=1` 可自动重挂 |
| 预设列表里出现两三个同名项 | 旧安装方式留下的裸行与新托管块并存 | 重新运行安装脚本，它会认领并合并旧行 |
| `js-yaml` 报 `unknown tag` | 文件里还有 `!!js` 标签 | `node scripts/doctor.mjs --fix`（先备份） |
| 预设根本没出现 | DSH 低于 0.2.1-rc.5，或装错了 profile | 升级 DSH，或用 `--profile` 指对 |
| 升级 DSH 后预设突然消失 | DSH 已超出 `engines` 上限 `<0.2.3-0`，插件在加载时被跳过 | 升级本包；确需强行加载可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 自担风险放行 |
预设补丁只定义 agent 侧的插件集合，不碰工作区选择器、目录选择器、终端这类 GUI 组件。如果装完后出现与预设无关的界面异常，请把 doctor 输出和浏览器控制台报错一起贴到 [issue](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/issues)。

readme.section: 与官方 PTC 预设的差异
readme.text:
| 官方有、本预设没有 | 影响 |
|---|---|
| `time-context` | 提示词里没有当前日期和时间，需要日期的任务请自己写明 |
| `tool-schedule` | 没有定时或周期任务工具 |
| `tool-plugin-market` | 不能在对话里装插件，请用 `dsh plugin` |

另外，预设声明了 `tool-subagent-codex`、`tool-subagent-claude-code`、`workflow-ptc`、`tool-workflow`、`tool-ralph` 和插件管理工具，但都处于禁用状态。需要这些能力时，用官方预设更省事。

- 在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 的 headless profile 里，两个预设和计划模式都停在 pending，不会生效（每次运行会提示 `3 entries did not activate`）。请在 web 或 desktop profile 中使用。`acp` 完全没验证过。
- macOS 没有在真机上验证过。安装脚本按 bash 3.2 兼容写法编写，并在三平台 CI 上运行。
- 补丁含 `!!js` 标签，由 DSH 加载器解析，第三方 YAML 解析器会报 unknown tag。安装脚本在写入 profile 前会把它解析成普通值。
- `glob` / `grep` 的只读并发标记只在插件管理器安装时才有（`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` 可关）；脚本安装路径本来就没有它。旧 id 解析同理由插件提供（`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS=0` 可关）。
- 计划模式组件的两个开关也可以从环境变量给：`DSH_PLAN_TODO_SYNC=off|remind|strict`（默认 `remind`）控制是否提醒/强制写 todo，`DSH_PLAN_LAG_TURNS=<n>`（默认 2）是进度落后几回合才提示；等价于插件配置里的 `todoSync` / `lagTurns`。
- 开发与测试主要围绕洛谷公开题库和上面的办公基准，其他类型任务的表现缺少数据。

```console
npm run verify          # 合成一致性、YAML、预设结构、文本审计、版本一致性、基准防泄漏等
npm run bench:office    # 办公基准的结构与完整性校验（只在仓库里可用，npm 包不含 benchmarks/）
bash scripts/selftest.sh
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 由 `presets/*.patch.yml` 合成，请勿手改，CI 会断言两者一致。README 里的实测表由 `docs/bench-office-results.json` 生成。贡献方式见 [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)。

- 第三轮审计修正：修掉「`--with-runtime` 装过再 `--uninstall` 会把补丁写成空文件、profile 起不来」这个回归（卸载顺序改成先撤运行时块，撤块时补回 `[]`）；Windows 的 `-Uninstall` 也会撤运行时覆盖。
- `tune-runtime` 不再静默忽略不认识的参数（`-Profile` 曾让它把覆盖写到所有 profile）；`doctor` 的第 3 节只判定现役两个预设、第 6 节不再建议装裸包名、发现问题时退出码 1；`install.sh --help` 不再截断末句。
- `publish.sh` / `publish.ps1` 删掉移动 tag 的逃生阀（查不到远端就拒绝执行，附件改为按 tag 打包）；`verify-versions` 开始检查安装器、marketplace 与两份 README 里写死的版本。
- npm 跳过 0.2.7 直接发 0.2.8：0.2.7 只存在于 GitHub tag `v0.2.7`。

- 第二轮审计修正：安装器文案与 `--with-runtime` 更名、`--uninstall` 撤掉运行时覆盖、`doctor --sessions` 不再崩溃、alias 表移除 `$comment`、peer 范围补上 0.2.2-rc.1、`NOTICE` 附上游 MIT 全文。
- 文档口径与实现对齐：README 顶部如实写出对整个 profile 生效的两项与关闭开关；「12 个历史 id」改为 5 个；修掉失效锚点与悬空引用；计划模式「贵 26%」按中位数订正为 17%。
- CI 加了 `0.2.2-rc.1` 的安装矩阵与「打包→解包→跑用户侧脚本」的 job，`bundle-install` 的断言从子串匹配改为精确 id。

- 预设收敛为两个：lite（13 条，默认）与 balance（3 条）；v1、v2 与实验变体移出发布包。
- 计划模式并回主包（plan-mode v1），与两个预设同在一张插件卡里。
- 新增运行时兼容层：5 个本包发布过的历史 preset id 解析到 lite，不改写会话文件。
- 新增组合自检、四层对齐审计（`npm run audit:align`）与 `glob` / `grep` 只读并发标记。
- 修复：DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 移除 `list-agents` 子路径后，预设卡片显示「加载失败」。

dsh-flash-presets

中文 | English

Agent presets for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), tuned for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

The idea is simple: compact the context earlier, keep only the head and tail of oversized tool output, leave unused tools out of the system prompt, and fold scattered tool calls into a single `run_code` program. None of this makes the model smarter. It changes how much a session reads, how much it wanders, and when it stops.

Everything ships as a DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle`). It inserts preset rows into a profile and doesn't touch the host source. **Three things do apply to the whole profile at runtime**: the resident PTC runtime (the `ptc-runtime` override in the patch, which affects **every** preset in that profile — the only way to switch it off is to remove this plugin card), the `glob` / `grep` concurrency marks (`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` disables them), and legacy preset-id resolution (`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS=0` disables that).

> Current version: 0.2.8 (2026-11-06) · presets v3 lite / v3 balance · plan mode plan-mode v1 (1.0.0) · requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.3-0` (an `engines` gate: installs are refused outside it, and at load time an out-of-range DSH skips this plugin — `dsh plugin allow-version` can override at your own risk; the script install doesn't go through this gate), tested on 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1
>
> When installing from npm, pin the version: `dsh-flash-presets@0.2.8`. **Do not install 0.2.5** — it cannot start a session on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (#19).

readme.section: Who it's for, and who it isn't
readme.text:
**A good fit for**

- Tasks with a clear goal and a way to check the result: changing code, running scripts, cleaning data, producing a file in a fixed format.
- Long sessions. DSH compacts at 80% of the context window by default, which most sessions never reach. These presets compact at 25%, so long sessions stay within bounds.
- Anyone who watches their token bill and would rather not repeat the same instructions in every message.

**Not a good fit for**

readme.section: Who it's for, and who it isn't
readme.text:
- Problems clearly beyond the model, such as competition-level tasks where the goal is partial credit. Standard mode holds up better there; see [measured evidence](docs/实测证据.md).
- Workflows that rely on the current date, installing plugins from inside a conversation, or scheduled tasks. Those capabilities are trimmed out (see [Differences from the official PTC preset](#differences-from-the-official-ptc-preset)).
- Models other than DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The rules may still help, but nobody has checked.
- DSH below 0.2.1-rc.5 (including 0.2.1-rc.2 through rc.4). Use the matching older release instead (see [versions and compatibility](docs/版本与兼容性.md), in Chinese). The directory-style presets for DSH before 0.1.7 are no longer shipped as of 0.2.6.

| Mechanism | When it acts | Setting | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Turn compaction | When the stored context grows too large | `thresholdRatio: 0.25`, `retainTokens: 20000` (DSH default: 0.8) | History is replaced by a summary; only long sessions trigger it |
| Tool-output trimming | When a tool result enters the context | first 4096 / last 1024 characters | Oversized output keeps only its two ends |
| Disabled plugins | When the system prompt is assembled | 6 plugins set to `disabled: true` | Their tool schemas never reach the prompt — a fixed saving |
| Behavioral rules | At every step the model takes | persona rules (13 in lite, 3 in balance) | Nudges the model to read less, batch calls, and edit incrementally |

- Tools are presented through PTC (`tool-presentation: ptc`), and the PTC runtime stays resident for the whole session (`ptc-runtime: persistent-in-memory`). Measured: the fixed startup cost per program dropped from 108 ms to about 0 (per the cost model), and nested tool calls from 44 ms to 15 ms ([benchmark notes](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/blob/main/docs/压测-run_code开销.md), in Chinese). The gain grows linearly with the number of calls inside a program; a short task that runs a single command will barely notice.
- The plugin marks `glob` and `grep` as safe to run concurrently, so several searches in the same turn can execute in parallel (plugin-manager installs of web / desktop only; the script install doesn't have it; `DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` disables it).
For the reasoning behind each setting, with source line references, see the [four mechanisms write-up](docs/技术文档-省token四机制.md) (Chinese).

| Preset | id | Rules | Compaction | Use it when |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 轻量PTC-v3 lite (Lean PTC-v3 lite; formerly lean-v3) | `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite` | 13 | 0.25 / 20k | Default. Covers most day-to-day work |
| 轻量PTC-v3 balance (Lean PTC-v3 balance) | `flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance` | 3 | 0.25 / 20k | Fewer rules, more room for the model to work its own way |

Both share the same compaction, trimming, plugin set, and PTC setup. Only the persona rules differ.

Lite's 13 rules fall into five groups: budget (count turns, not steps; aim for 20 or fewer, and stop to re-plan past roughly 60), sequencing (think briefly, run one cheap probe, and for submission tasks ship the smallest working artifact first), verification (one consolidated acceptance pass, then deliver — no extra random or stress rounds), tools and output (read files with read/glob/grep, batch calls, edit incrementally), and scope (answer in the user's language, stay in scope, keep secrets out of the session, switch approach after two failures).

Balance keeps only the three rules the harness can't enforce on its own: respect the user's language and scope, never put secrets into the session, and after two failed attempts change approach and report the exact command and output.

Does the number of rules matter? Across three task sets we tested up to four arms — 0, 3, 7 and 13 rules (all four on the algorithm bed; 0/3/13 and 3/13 on the other two), n = 5–15 — and found no measurable difference in either quality or tokens ([measured evidence](docs/实测证据.md), "三床 × 四臂"). At that sample size, differences smaller than about 2× are undetectable, so the honest reading is "no difference observed", not "no difference". The savings come mainly from the first three mechanisms above and from PTC, not from the wording of the rules.
> A naming note for the evidence files: in the 2026-11-04 experiments, "v3" means the 13-rule preset (today's lite) and "lite" means the 3-rule preset (today's balance). The rename happened in 0.2.6.
Every number below comes with its conditions and sample size. The experiments use different setups, so don't compare across tables.

The plugin manager installs the whole plugin card: both presets, the plan-mode component, the resident PTC runtime, and the legacy-id compatibility layer.

```console

readme.section: 0.2.8 from npm, pinned to the version
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-flash-presets@0.2.8

readme.section: or the same release as a tag, if you'd rather not use npm
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets#v0.2.8
```

`--profile` is normally `web` or `desktop` (presets don't activate under `headless`, and `acp` is untested — see [Known limitations](#known-limitations)). Entering the package name or GitHub address under Plugins → Add plugin in the GUI does the same thing.

readme.section: or the same release as a tag, if you'd rather not use npm
readme.text: Presets directly shape agent behavior, so pin a version when you need reproducible results. With a bare npm name the manager records a caret range, and any later pnpm operation may move you to the newest 0.2.x; a `github:` install records a git ref (`#v0.2.8`) instead and won't drift.

readme.section: Offline, or with the install script
readme.text:
Download and unpack the archive from [Releases](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/releases), or clone the tag:

```bash
git clone --depth 1 -b v0.2.8 https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets.git
cd dsh-flash-presets
bash scripts/install.sh --profile web                  # Windows: scripts\install.ps1 -Profile web
```

readme.section: Offline, or with the install script
readme.text: The script writes a single managed block containing the two preset rows into the profile patch. It backs up the file first, and re-running it never creates a second block. The plan-mode component, the legacy-id layer, and the composition self-check are part of the plugin itself and only load when installed through the plugin manager. The plan-mode component, the legacy-id layer, the composition self-check and the `glob`/`grep` concurrency marks are all part of the plugin, so only a plugin-manager install brings them. With `--with-runtime` (formerly `--with-plan-mode`; `-WithRuntime` in PowerShell) the script also writes a profile-level `ptc-runtime: persistent-in-memory` — that one applies to **every** preset in the profile, and `--uninstall` removes it too.

readme.section: Offline, or with the install script
readme.text: The two paths are either/or: if the script already wrote the preset rows and you want the plugin card instead, run `--uninstall` first. Having both does not error out (`--dump-config` still exits 0), but every preset shows up twice in the picker (8 preset rows measured in the patch). `agent-preset/invalid` is the error code for a **preset definition that fails to parse**, not for duplicates.

Presets and runtime settings are read once, at process start.

- `web` profile: reload the page.
- `desktop`: quit the host completely and start it again. The classic symptom of skipping this is "the plugin is installed, but the `run_code` speedup isn't there".
- `headless` / `acp`: presets don't activate there anyway (`headless` measured, `acp` untested), so there is nothing to restart.

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c 'id: preset-'             # 6 (4 built-in + 2 from this package, with no other preset packages)
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c 'persistent-in-memory'    # 1
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c 'plan-mode-ui'            # 1
node scripts/doctor.mjs --profile web                                # version, duplicate rows, !!js, YAML parsing in one pass

Those `node scripts/...` paths assume you're in the repository (or the unpacked release archive). With a plugin-manager install the scripts live inside the profile: `node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-flash-presets/scripts/doctor.mjs --profile web`.

To update, run the same `add` again, or `remove` and then `add`.

To uninstall:

```console
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-flash-presets     # if installed with the plugin manager
bash scripts/install.sh --uninstall --profile web     # if installed with the script (Windows: scripts\install.ps1 -Uninstall)
```

pnpm leaves one line for this package in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and `remove` doesn't clear it. It has no effect on the composed configuration.

- Preset ids changed: the 13-rule preset moved from `flash-lean-ptc-v3` to `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite`, and the former 3-rule `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite` is now `flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance`.
- Old sessions still open. A runtime compatibility layer resolves the 5 ids this package ever published (`flash-lean`, `flash-lean-ptc`, `-v1`, `-v2`, `-v3`) to lite; ids used only in local experiments can be added through `DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS_EXTRA`. It steps in only when resolution fails and never rewrites a session file. The mapping is in [`presets/legacy-preset-map.json`](presets/legacy-preset-map.json); the design is described in [preset id contract and upgrades](docs/预设-id-契约与升级.md) (Chinese).
- If you installed the standalone `dsh-plan-mode-ui` package, run `dsh plugin remove dsh-plan-mode-ui` first, or plan mode will be injected twice.
- If the profile's `selectedDefault` still points at an old id, new sessions fail with `Unknown agent preset`. Set it to `flash-lean-ptc-v3-lite`.

The same plugin card carries a plan-mode component, plan-mode v1 (1.0.0). Within a single turn, the agent writes a plan, waits for your approval, then executes it, and writes the measured acceptance results back to the card at the end. The two halves divide the work cleanly: the presets govern how each turn spends its budget; plan mode makes the turn think before it acts.

- The control sits to the left of the input box, with off / light / full levels independent of the preset.
- Light is the recommended default. In a comparison with n = 3 and 7 acceptance checks, both levels passed 3/3; full used about 17% more tokens (median 40.2k vs 34.3k) and about 33% more time (196 s vs 147 s) ([changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md), Chinese).
- If you don't want it, switch the component off on the card. The presets behave exactly the same without it.

readme.section: Getting the most out of it
readme.text:
- **State the goal and how success is checked.** The sharper the criteria, the better the result; when the boundaries are fuzzy, pair it with plan or goal mode. The P15654 comparison is in [measured evidence](docs/实测证据.md).
- **Raise the output limit.** 120K or more is recommended, 384K if you can, so long reasoning isn't cut off.
- **On Windows**, install PowerShell 7 (the MSI build) or Git Bash first.
- **Give long-thinking models one problem per session.** Handed several at once, a model may lay out every plan in a single response and get cut off upstream before it ever acts ([measured evidence](docs/实测证据.md), "跨模型").

Run the checkup before guessing:

```bash
node scripts/doctor.mjs --profile web          # add --dump to also run dsh --dump-config
node scripts/diag-preset-load.mjs --profile desktop   # when a preset card in the GUI shows "failed to load"
```

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| A preset card shows "failed to load" | A plugin the preset references can't be resolved. Most often a hand-edited preset still lists `.../dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents`, a subpath DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 removed | Locate it with `diag-preset-load.mjs` and delete that row |
| The compact / plan / goal slash commands disappear, and the next message fails with `tool executor is unavailable` | A plugin hot reload released the preset composition of an open session and didn't remount it | Restart DSH. The plugin checks every 2 minutes and logs the remedy; set `DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_SELFCHECK_HEAL=1` to remount automatically |
| Two or three presets with the same name | Bare rows from an old install sit next to the new managed block | Re-run the install script; it adopts and merges the old rows |
| `js-yaml` reports `unknown tag` | The file still contains `!!js` tags | `node scripts/doctor.mjs --fix` (back up first) |
| The presets don't appear at all | DSH is older than 0.2.1-rc.5, or the wrong profile was targeted | Upgrade DSH, or point `--profile` at the right one |
| The presets vanish after a DSH upgrade | DSH went past the `engines` ceiling `<0.

The preset patch only defines the agent-side plugin set. It doesn't touch GUI pieces such as the workspace picker, the directory picker, or the terminal. If something unrelated to presets breaks after installing, please open an [issue](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/issues) with the doctor output and the browser console errors.

readme.section: Differences from the official PTC preset
readme.text:
| In the official preset, not here | What it means |
|---|---|
| `time-context` | The prompt carries no current date or time; state it yourself when a task needs it |
| `tool-schedule` | No tool for scheduled or recurring tasks |
| `tool-plugin-market` | No installing plugins from inside a conversation; use `dsh plugin` |

readme.section: Differences from the official PTC preset
readme.text: The presets also declare `tool-subagent-codex`, `tool-subagent-claude-code`, `workflow-ptc`, `tool-workflow`, `tool-ralph`, and the plugin-manager tools, all disabled. If you need any of these, the official preset is the easier choice.

- Under the headless profile on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, both presets and plan mode stay pending and never take effect (each run reports `3 entries did not activate`). Use the web or desktop profile. `acp` is completely unverified.
- macOS hasn't been verified on real hardware. The install script is written for bash 3.2 and runs in CI on all three platforms.
- The patch contains `!!js` tags that the DSH loader resolves; third-party YAML parsers report an unknown tag. The install script resolves them to plain values before writing to the profile.
- The `glob` / `grep` concurrency marks only exist in a plugin-manager install (`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` disables them); the script install never has them. Legacy-id resolution comes from the plugin too (`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS=0`).
- The plan-mode component also reads two environment variables: `DSH_PLAN_TODO_SYNC=off|remind|strict` (default `remind`) controls whether todo writes are reminded or required, and `DSH_PLAN_LAG_TURNS=<n>` (default 2) is how many turns behind the run may fall before a nudge; they mirror the `todoSync` / `lagTurns` plugin config keys.
- Development and testing centered on the public Luogu problem set and the off

```console
npm run verify          # composition, YAML, preset structure, text lint, version consistency, benchmark leak guard, and more
npm run bench:office    # structure and integrity checks for the office benchmark (repo only; the npm package excludes benchmarks/)
bash scripts/selftest.sh
```

`cordis.patch.yml` is composed from `presets/*.patch.yml`; don't edit it by hand — CI asserts the two match. The measurement table in this README is generated from `docs/bench-office-results.json`. See [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to contribute.

- Third-round audit fixes: the regression where `--with-runtime` followed by `--uninstall` left an empty patch file and the profile would not boot (uninstall now reverts the runtime block first, and the revert restores `[]`); Windows `-Uninstall` now removes the runtime override too.
- `tune-runtime` no longer silently ignores unknown arguments (`-Profile` used to apply the override to every profile); `doctor` checks only the two current presets in section 3, no longer suggests installing the bare package name in section 6, and exits 1 when it finds problems; `install.sh --help` no longer truncates its last line.
- `publish.sh` / `publish.ps1` drop the move-the-tag escape hatch (they refuse to run when the remote tag can't be queried, and archive by tag); `verify-versions` now checks the versions hard-coded in the installers, the marketplace entry, and both READMEs.

- Second-round audit fixes: installer wording and the `--with-runtime` rename, `--uninstall` now removes the runtime override, `doctor --sessions` no longer crashes, the alias table no longer carries `$comment`, the peer range covers 0.2.2-rc.1, and `NOTICE` carries the upstream MIT text.
- Docs now match the implementation: the top of this README states the two things that apply to the whole profile and how to switch them off; "12 historical ids" became 5; broken anchors and a dangling reference are gone; plan mode's "26% more expensive" is corrected to 17% (medians).
- CI gained a 0.2.2-rc.1 install matrix entry and a pack → unpack → run-user-scripts job, and `bundle-install` now compares exact ids instead of substrings.

- Two presets remain: lite (13 rules, default) and balance (3 rules). v1, v2, and the experimental variants are no longer shipped.
- Plan mode moved back into the main package (plan-mode v1), on the same plugin card as the two presets.
- New runtime compatibility layer: the 5 ids this package ever published resolve to lite without rewriting session files.
- New composition self-check, a four-layer alignment audit (`npm run audit:align`), and read-only concurrency marks for `glob` / `grep`.
- Fixed: preset cards showed "failed to load" after DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 removed the `list-agents` subpath.
